incoming.name: Trafalgar Square
incoming.excerpt: The square is a popular tourist spot in London, and used to be particularly famous for its pigeons (Rock Pigeons).

outgoing.name: Asia
outgoing.excerpt: The Rock Pigeon has a restricted natural resident range in western and southern Europe, North Africa, and into southwest Asia.

outgoing.name: Cubism

outgoing.name: Italy
